scripts.build: npm run build --workspace openspec-min && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check && node --test test/*.test.mjs src/openspec-min/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.release: npm test && node scripts/release.mjs && npm run test:release
scripts.test:release: npm run build && node scripts/check.mjs && node scripts/smoke-release.mjs
